#!/bin/sh
#
# This script sets up a bunch of environment variables that the Technicolor
# EasyMesh stack needs. Please remove variables from this script when better
# methods for obtaining this information is implemented.
#
# These variables can be overridden by setting new values in $PWD/ecd.conf
#
# Once the environment variables are set, it runs /usr/bin/ecd

CONF_FILE="$HOME/ecd.conf"

# ecd variables
ECD_LOG_SINK=syslog
#ECD_LOG_SINK=stdout
#ECD_LOG_LEVEL=debug
ECD_LOG_LEVEL=info
ECD_EXTRA_OPTIONS=

# if file is not exist, do next, if not , wait and check
if [ -e /configs/em_no_auto_startup_flag ] ; then
    exit 0
fi

if [ -e ${CONF_FILE} ] ; then
  . ${CONF_FILE}
fi

# exec ECD to save memory
#exec /usr/bin/ecd --log-path=$ECD_LOG_SINK --log-level=$ECD_LOG_LEVEL $ECD_EXTRA_OPTIONS
# exec ecd without arguments, since that is not needed anymore
exec /usr/bin/ecd

# Incl ude a rule file
#INCLUDE = filename.pcd
################### Start of a rule block #############################
# Index of the rule
#RULE = GROUPNAME_RULENAME
RULE = service_ECD
# Condition to start rule, existence of one of the following
#
# NONE - No start condition, application is spawn immediately
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# RULE_COMPLETED id - Rule id completed successfully
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# ENV_VAR name, value - Value of a variable
#
#START_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; PNAME pname; RULE_COMPLETED id; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner, STATUS script, status }
START_COND = RULE_COMPLETED service_system_init service_NVA
# Command with parameters, NONE for sync point
#COMMAND = cmd parameters...
COMMAND = /usr/bin/run_ecd.sh
# Scheduling (priority) of the process
#SCHED = { NICE value; FIFO value }
SCHED = NICE 0
# Daemon flag Process must not end
#DAEMON = { YES, NO }
DAEMON = YES
# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for one of the following:
#
# NONE - No monitor on the result, just spawn application and continue.
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# EXIT status - The application exited with status. Other statuses are considered failure
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# PROCESS_READY The process sent a READY event though PCD API.
# WAIT msecs - Delay, ignore END_COND_TIMEOUT
#
#END_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; EXIT status; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner; WAIT msecs; PROCESS_READY }
END_COND = NONE
# Timeout for end condition. Fail if timeout expires. -1 if not relevant.
#END_COND_TIMEOUT = msecs
END_COND_TIMEOUT = -1
# Action upon failure, do one of the following actions upon failure
# NONE Do not take any action
# REBOOT - Reboot the system
# RESTART - Restart the rule
# EXEC_RULE id - Execute a rule
#
#FAILURE_ACTION = { NONE, REBOOT, RESTART, EXEC_RULE id }
FAILURE_ACTION = RESTART
# if RESTART is followed by a number, it will the number of restart allowed in FAILURE_RESET_COUNT hour(s). After this number of fail, the action will be definitively NONE.
# Action upon second failure (only if the first one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION2 = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Action upon next failures (only if the second one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION_NEXT = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Interval in seconds between a failure and the next failure action.
# FAILURE_INTERVAL = (0..4294967)
# Time in hours before resetting the failure counter. 0: use only the first failure action.
# FAILURE_RESET_COUNT = (0..1193)
# Rule is Active or not (To be activated later by PCD API)
#ACTIVE = { YES, NO }
ACTIVE = NO
# User id for the process
# USER = { UID | User name }
# ping time out ,Fail if timeout expires.
# ALIVE_TIMEOUT = 10000
################### End of a rule block #############################

config main main
       option manufacturer NOKIA_BEACON_1
       option version 1.0-20-capin
       option debug 2
       option config_mode http
       option notify_mode http
       option server xca-back.dev2.homewifi.nokia.com
       option port 8443
       option use_tls 1
       option ca_path /etc/ssl/certs
       option ca_info /etc/ssl/certs/L2_server_cert.pem
       option special_bootup_flag 1
       option bootup_flag_check 0
       option sta_connection_percentage 20
       option radio_access_type_2g 0
       option radio_access_type_5g 0
       option off_channel_scan_5g 1
       option username "admin"
       option password "admin"
       option compression_type gzip
       option compression_level medium
       option dns_addr_resolve ipv4
       option connection_age_time 0
       option log_file_size 512000
       option compress_log_file 1

config interfaces interfaces
       option base_interface_2G rax0
       option base_interface_5G ra0

config url_path url_path
       option server_path '/NGSCserver'
       option fault_path '/FMserver'
       option config_data_path '/apEntries/phyAPConfiguration'
       option metric_report_path '/apEntries/schemaLessApMetrics'
       option fault_report_path '/apEntries/faultNotification'

config intervals intervals
       option base_wakeup_time 30
       option config_polling_interval 6
       option metric_report_interval  30
       option neighbor_report_scan_interval 20
       option neighbor_ap_scan_interval 2880
       option perf_scan_interval 2
       option perf_report_interval 30
       option noise_evaluation_period 5
       option cloud_config_retry_interval 3
       option dns_cache_tout 1800
       option idle_throughput '20'
       option curr_chn_obss_threshold '90'
       option idle_threshold '0'

config location location
       option posx 0
       option posy 0
       option posz 0
       option lat 0
       option long 0
       option alt 0

config fault fault
       option quick_report 1
       option noise_threshold -80

config rssi_penalty rssi_penalty
       option maxrssi_threshold_1 -13
       option maxrssi_penalty_1 0
       option maxrssi_threshold_2 -23
       option maxrssi_penalty_2 0

config noise_threshold noise_threshold

config adaptative_scan adaptative_scan
       option scan_mode 1
       option scan_mode_5 1
       option mode_type_1 0.5,5,2,5,15
       option mode_type_2 1,20,2,15,60
       option mode_type_3 0.2,5,5,60,0

config 80211h_csa 80211h_csa
       option spect_mode_2g 1
       option spect_mode_5g 1
       option csa_count_2g 5
       option csa_count_5g 5
       option noise_threshold -65

config 80211h_dfs 80211h_dfs

config rrm rrm

config status status
       option enabled 0

# NONE - No monitor on the result, just spawn application and continue.
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# EXIT status - The application exited with status. Other statuses are considered failure
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# PROCESS_READY The process sent a READY event though PCD API.
# WAIT msecs - Delay, ignore END_COND_TIMEOUT
#
#END_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; EXIT status; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner; WAIT msecs; PROCESS_READY }
END_COND = NONE
# Timeout for end condition. Fail if timeout expires. -1 if not relevant.
#END_COND_TIMEOUT = msecs
END_COND_TIMEOUT = -1
# Action upon failure, do one of the following actions upon failure
# NONE Do not take any action
# REBOOT - Reboot the system
# RESTART - Restart the rule
# EXEC_RULE id - Execute a rule
#
#FAILURE_ACTION = { NONE, REBOOT, RESTART, EXEC_RULE id }
FAILURE_ACTION = RESTART
# if RESTART is followed by a number, it will the number of restart allowed in FAILURE_RESET_COUNT hour(s). After this number of fail, the action will be definitively NONE.
# Action upon second failure (only if the first one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION2 = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Action upon next failures (only if the second one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION_NEXT = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Interval in seconds between a failure and the next failure action.
# FAILURE_INTERVAL = (0..4294967)
# Time in hours before resetting the failure counter. 0: use only the first failure action.
# FAILURE_RESET_COUNT = (0..1193)
# Rule is Active or not (To be activated later by PCD API)
#ACTIVE = { YES, NO }
ACTIVE = NO
# User id for the process
# USER = { UID | User name }
# ping time out ,Fail if timeout expires.
# ALIVE_TIMEOUT = 10000

# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# RULE_COMPLETED id - Rule id completed successfully
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device

START_COND = FILE /tmp/pcd_start_ecd_ready

# Command with parameters, NONE for sync point
#COMMAND = cmd parameters...
COMMAND = /usr/bin/run_ecd.sh

# Scheduling (priority) of the process
#SCHED = { NICE value; FIFO value }
SCHED = NICE 0

# Daemon flag ¡§C Process must not end

# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for one of the following:

# Interval in seconds between a failure and the next failure action.
